description: Round 17, Codex (not blocking, conservative): `@pytest.mark.xfail` on a parametrised test one of whose cases is already an xfail (`pytest.param(…, marks=pytest.mark.xfail)`): `test_x[1]` becomes an expected failure (passed → xpassed), `test_x[2]` was one already. A case's own marks are another effect on the same test (F6): WARN, recoverable (docs/known-limitations.md).
